story.iWant: every AI answer to include source citations
story.soThat: I can verify the information myself

task.item: Create CitationService in apps/api/app/services/citation_service.py
Method: async def add_citations(answer_text, context_chunks) -> AnnotatedAnswer
Split answer into sentences using NLP library (spacy)
For each sentence: calculate semantic similarity with context chunks (threshold 0.7)
Match sentence to source chunks: primary source (highest similarity) + co-sources (>0.6)
Generate citation markup: inline format [Source: doc, section] or footnote format [1]
Return annotated answer with citation references embedded
Create Citation model: {sentence_id, chunk_id, document_name, section, similarity}
Store citations in database for analytics and verification
Link citations to Answer record for traceability
Create Citation component: clickable citation link with tooltip
Inline format: "According to [Returns Policy, Section 2.1]..."
Footnote format: "...30-day refund.[1]" with reference list below
Click handler: opens source chunk in side panel or modal
Tooltip: shows full source and similarity score on hover
Style: blue underlined text for citations (distinct visual)
Create SourceViewerPanel component: displays full context chunk when citation clicked
Show: document title, section, page number, full chunk text, similarity score
Highlight sentence in chunk that matches citation
Test: every factual statement has citation
Test: citation text matches actual chunk text
Test: multiple chunks supporting statement → all cited
Test: synthesized statements flagged (no valid citation)

criterion.title: Citation Inclusion
criterion.then: every factual statement includes a citation to source

criterion.title: Citation Format
criterion.then: citation format is clear and clickable AND citations link to actual source document chunk

criterion.title: Citation Metadata
criterion.then: citation includes: document name, section (if available), page number (if PDF)

criterion.title: Footnote Citation Format
criterion.then: format is: "...30-day refund window.[1]" with "[1] Returns Policy.pdf, Page 3" below

criterion.title: Hover Tooltip
criterion.then: tooltip shows full source and relevance score (similarity %)

criterion.title: Citation Accuracy
criterion.then: citation text matches the actual chunk text AND citation source matches the document metadata

criterion.title: Multiple Source Citations
criterion.then: ALL supporting chunks are cited (not just the top one)

criterion.title: Clickable Citations
criterion.then: source chunk opens in side panel or new tab AND I can read full source context

criterion.title: Citation Visual Style
criterion.then: citation color is distinct (blue, underlined) for clear identification

constraints.constraint: Citation must match actual chunk text (no fabricated sources)
Citations must be clickable and open source context
Citation post-processing adds <200ms to answer generation
Use semantic similarity (threshold 0.7) to match sentences to chunks

interface.name: CitationService
interface.notes: Post-processes answer to add citation markup. Matches sentences to source chunks using semantic similarity.

interface.name: Citation Component
interface.notes: Renders clickable citation link with tooltip. Opens source viewer on click.

tests.standards: Test citation accuracy: every factual statement cited. Test citation UI: clickable, opens source. Test semantic matching: sentences correctly matched to chunks. Frameworks: pytest (backend), Vitest (frontend).

ideas.test: Multiple chunks cited if they support statement
ideas.testE2E: Generate answer → verify citations present → click citation → verify source displayed
